rule: Multiple output strings are not automatically answer versions. Only explicitly reviewed task contracts may treat them as alternatives. Jointly required items, unresolved reference contracts and bare factual tasks remain held.
joint_reference_reason: Quoref contains separately stored required entity names; TORQUE and LIMIT require all events/entities but store individual items. DROP includes conflicting numeric alternatives and multi-span contracts. Hotpot supporting facts can be individual incomplete support sentences conditioned on a supplied answer. Entire cohorts are held pending source-specific complete-answer reconstruction and fresh quality gates; never select one item as the whole answer.
bare_fact_reason: Inspected contracts require factual trivia, missing-table HybridQA, clinical domain facts or numeric world facts, with no supporting evidence supplied for the target question. Different-input worked examples do not supply missing target facts. Exclude this cohort until actual query-only retrieval supplies evidence.
benchmark_scope_reason: Conservative source-family exclusion for known benchmark batteries whose original train/evaluation provenance is not established by an NI training-task designation. This is additional to the existing local exact/13-gram overlap screen, not a claim of universal benchmark decontamination.
